atoms.a: To keep healthy, it is good to do lots of exercise. This could be running, or walking, or even swimming. The suggestions are endless!
All of the lions in England are kept in zoos, so they aren’t walking on the street. They are fed here and have room to run.
On holiday, you can go snorkelling and see many different varieties of fish. They are so beautiful. You could also see a starfish or even a crab.
Italy is known for pizza and pasta. My favourite food is spaghetti carbonara, but pizza is also good. My favourite kind of pizza is pepperoni. I would love to visit Italy one day.

Billions of people watch the Olympics. My parents love to watch it. There are many different sports in the Olympics, such as swimming, fencing and judo. If I train hard enough, I might make it to the Olympics!
Shopping is fun to do with friends. We enjoy going to the shopping centre and trying on different outfits. Today I bought a new shirt. I think it is one of my favourite activities.

atoms.text: Houseplants are not only a good house decoration, but they are also very good for your health.
They purify the air and can decrease stress levels.
Purifying the air means they produce oxygen for us to breathe.

atoms.text: The Sun is very old and very hot.
It is about four billion years old and too hot for anyone to get close to.
This means that you could never visit the sun on holiday!
